label: PF Backlog 630
title: Framework-agnostic skills home + resolver
body:
## Problem / why
UI/UX skills live only under .opencode/skills/*/SKILL.md, coupling PF to the harness and leaving them unregistered.

## Goal & value
PF owns the skill bodies; .opencode is a legacy fallback only.

## In scope
- Copy the 8 UI/UX skills into pipeline/skills/<id>/SKILL.md (body+frontmatter+LICENSE verbatim).
- Neutral-first resolver (Go op skills.resolve/list/describe) via core/go_host.py.
- Register in pipeline/skills-registry.json (single skills catalog); expose ui-ux/design-systems layer metadata via config/knowledge-registry.json.

## Out of scope
- Migrating non-UI skills
- Deleting .opencode (kept as legacy fallback).

## Definition of Done
- wired_audit green (no unwired file).
- skills.resolve covered by a unit test.

## Verification
Structured `acceptance_criteria` is the single source of truth for verification.
